name: Bagh-Chal: Tiger & Goat
subtitle: Nepal's tiger and goat game
shortDescription: Nepal's tiger and goat board game. 44 puzzles, 14 lessons. Works offline.
longDescription:
Bagh-Chal is the traditional tiger and goat board game of Nepal, in a complete edition with a carved three-dimensional board and real tiger and goat portraits.

Four tigers face twenty goats on a square board of twenty-five points. The goats try to trap the tigers so none can move. The tigers try to capture enough goats to win. It takes a minute to learn and a long time to master.

### Play Your Way
- Play as the goats or as the tigers against the computer, with five levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, Master and Adaptive.
- Two players on one device: pass it across the table.
- Auto Play: watch the computer play both sides, pause at any time, and compare with your own guess.
- A coach, hints and take-back to help you learn.
- A Daily challenge.
- Works in portrait and landscape.

### Learn The Game
- Campaign: 44 puzzles in four chapters. Each has one winning first move; earn stars for no wrong try and no hint.
- Academy: 14 short, hands-on lessons, from the basics to strategy. Nothing is timed.
- Heritage: 6 short chapters on the game, its name and its family.
- Rules: the full rules, with text size up to 300 percent.

### Collect And Customise
- Meet 12 tiger and goat breeds, with what is well established about each animal.
- Unlock new tigers and goats as you play.
- Choose your board and scenery.
- 18 achievements and statistics kept on your device.

Free to play with ads. An optional monthly subscription removes ads, or you can watch a short video to play ad-free for a while.
whatsNew: Ad-free options on the About page: watch a short video, or subscribe monthly. Banner and level-break ads only in the free version.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
